artworks.title: Clytemnestra
artworks.description: Collier's Clytemnestra with the axe — the bath-murder at Mycenae that Homer tells through Agamemnon's shade and Apollodorus sets beside Aegisthus' shared guilt.

artworks.title: The Murder of Agamemnon
artworks.description: Guérin stages the king's homecoming turned slaughter — Cassandra's doom, the long memory of Iphigenia at Aulis, and the infant Orestes saved for vengeance.
